text: 9月11日，多只宽基ETF成交显著放量。过去一周（9月4日至9月10日），股票型ETF资金净流入超过百亿元，其中，宽基ETF成为“吸金”主力。站在当前时点，多位绩优基金经理表示，看好权益资产长期表现。展望后市，机构普遍持乐观态度。融通基金基金经理李进表示，在近期调整之后，现阶段市场整体估值相对较低，对后市持审慎乐观态度。其中，制造业红利叠加品牌力，成本比海外对手低，加上产品迭代速度、研发周期有极强优势，让一批出海标的公司显现出了足够韧性，海外市场份额不断提升。（上海证券报）
text_en: On September 11, trading volume in multiple broad-based ETFs increased significantly. Over the past week (September 4 to September 10), net inflows into equity ETFs exceeded 10 billion yuan, with broad-based ETFs being the main force attracting capital. At the current juncture, several fund managers with strong performance expressed optimism about the long-term performance of equity assets. Looking ahead, institutions are generally optimistic. Li Jin, fund manager at Rongtong Fund, said that after the recent correction, overall market valuations are relatively low at present, and he holds a cautiously optimistic view on the outlook. Among them, the combination of manufacturing advantages and brand strength, lower costs compared with overseas competitors, and strong advantages in product iteration speed and R&D cycles have allowed a group of companies with overseas expansion to demonstrate sufficient resilience, with their overseas market share continuously rising. (Shanghai Securities News)
